figures.finding: A resident pays nothing on the first $18,200, then 16% to $45,000, 30% to $135,000, 37% to $190,000 and 45% above in 2025-26; the first rate falls to 15% for 2026-27 and 14% from 2027-28. A 2% Medicare levy is added on taxable income (none at or below $28,011).

figures.finding: An employer withholds PAYG from a resident's weekly pay by the Commissioner's formula y = ax − b on weekly earnings x (whole dollars plus 99 cents), rounded to the dollar; for a payee claiming the tax-free threshold (scale 2) from 1 July 2026 nothing is withheld below $362 a week, then a runs from 0.15 to 0.47 (2025-26, from 24 September 2025: from 0.16, nothing below $361).

value.formula: y = ax − b, weekly; x = whole dollars of weekly earnings + 0.99; rounded to the nearest dollar

figures.applies: Employees paid weekly (fortnightly and monthly pay are converted to the weekly equivalent per the instrument), before tax offsets and Medicare levy adjustments.
